title: 環境土木専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises B
educationalGoal: Students will learn skills that relate to actual phenomena, and apply those skills through experiments and exercises illustrating geoinformatics, hydraulics, and reinforced concrete engineering.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Geographic information systems (6 weeks) 2. Flow of water (5 weeks) 3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams (3 weeks) 4. Overall across-field exercises (1 week) Details of the schedule are explained during the first lesson. Students should bring a PC and LAN cable to each class since laptops and the Internet are integral to learning about geographic information systems.
books: Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises A,B (Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: 1. Students need familiarity with geographic information systems, basic map information, and digital maps 2. Students must understand laminar air flow and turbulent flow, mean fluid velocity and flow velocity distribution, objects’ resistance coefficients, Venturi meters, and the characteristics of waves 3. Students need to be acquainted with the mixture proportion of concrete, compressive strength, and bending of reinforced concrete beams

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
